perl5lib.description: Perl library path(s) required by RT. Colon-separated list of directories.

rt_home.description: RT installation home directory (contains bin/, lib/, etc.).

web_path.description: URL path where RT will be accessible (e.g., 'rt' → http://example.com/rt/).

use_ssl.description: Enable HTTPS and redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

ssl_redirect_host.description: Base URL for SSL redirect (e.g., 'https://rt.example.com'). Defaults to 'https://' + server_name.

server_name.description: Server hostname (used if ssl_redirect_host not specified).

auth_realm.description: Authentication realm displayed in login prompt.

htpasswd_file.description: Path to htpasswd file for basic authentication (used when auth_type='htaccess').

ldap_url.description: LDAP URL for user authentication and lookup (used when auth_type='ldap').

ldap_bind_dn.description: Bind DN for LDAP queries (used when auth_type='ldap').

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for LDAP bind DN (used when auth_type='ldap'). Should be stored securely (e.g., via Apache env vars or file permissions).

cors_enabled.description: Enable Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) for API or embedded widgets.

cors_origin.description: Allowed origin for CORS (e.g., 'https://dashboard.example.com'). Use '*' for all origins (not recommended in production).

fastcgi_max_processes.description: Maximum number of FastCGI processes (controls concurrency). Adjust based on server capacity.

environment_vars.description: Additional environment variables to pass to RT (key-value pairs).

extra_directives.description: List of additional Apache directives (e.g., custom headers, rewrite rules, logging). One per list item.
